subject.title: RFC: Skill routing metadata and evaluation hints for Harness-style OpenClaw setups

question: Should ClawHub adopt an additive advisory routing-metadata contract now, and which fields should be registry facts versus unverified author hints?
rationale: Field semantics, cross-skill/plugin scope, abuse controls, and the security meaning of self-declared risk require maintainer intent before stable schema and API commitments are made.

options.title: Approve a narrow advisory v1
options.body: Add optional intents and verification hints while excluding trusted risk scoring and server-side ranking until usage is evaluated.

options.title: Prototype outside the public contract
options.body: Collect examples and routing evaluations in an experimental index without changing stable manifest or API schemas yet.

options.title: Decline registry routing metadata
options.body: Keep routing in external harnesses using existing descriptions, content, and search results to avoid another long-lived contract.

recommendation.title: Approve a narrow advisory v1
recommendation.body: Add optional intents and verification hints while excluding trusted risk scoring and server-side ranking until usage is evaluated.

likelyOwner.reason: The historical metadata-documentation introduction is the strongest available ownership signal for deciding the initial contract boundary.
